description: Receipt files written to disk rely on wall-clock time (datetime.datetime.now(timezone.utc)). If the system clock steps backward during execution (e.g., via NTP adjustment or leap second), timestamps between consecutive rounds will become non-monotonic, causing run_verify in verify.py to fail timestamp validation at runtime.
